content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am from Mexico and new to this field. I am working with [product_name] [version_no]. I tried connecting to AWS to create a device, but after the third step I received a message: 'Can't connect to AWS IoT. Make sure your computer is connected to the Internet and the passkey is valid.' I have verified that my access key and password are correct, so it seems the problem might be with internet connectivity. In the access control settings, it shows: Cloud access: secure. If anyone has suggestions to fix this, I would appreciate your input! Thank you all for your help and support. Sincerely, [user_name]

Hi, To check if internet is available for [product_name] with display or [product_name] TDE: - Go to [product_name] and navigate down until you see the date and time. - Press ESC and go to the DIAGNOSTICS menu. - Select TOOLS. - Choose PING. Enter the IP address: 008.008.008.008 (Google server) and press ENTER. The device will send a ping to the Google server. If internet access is available, 'OK' should appear on the display. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user tried connecting a [product_name] [version_no] to AWS IoT and faced a connection error despite valid credentials. The main concern seems to be internet connectivity configuration, with another user providing step-by-step guidance to confirm network status through the device's diagnostic menu.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable network connectivity between the [product_name] [version_no] and AWS IoT, and hopes for easy troubleshooting steps and clear indications when network access is unavailable.
